z_comum.desc: a zombie lurching forward like a sleepwalker with BOTH arms raised and stretched straight out in front of it, horizontal and parallel to the ground at shoulder height, limp wrists with hands dangling down, greenish gray rotten skin, torn brown shirt, black X-shaped stitches across the forehead, mouth hanging open, slightly hunched, facing right

z_corredor.desc: a thin lanky runner zombie in a torn red shirt sprinting toward the right, face and body pointing right, torso leaning forward, mouth open with exposed teeth, glowing red eyes, clawed hands reaching forward

z_blindado.desc: a zombie in heavy gray riot gear: a gray metal riot helmet with a dark smoked face shield pulled down over the whole face, a bulky gray armored vest with large round rivets, metal shoulder pads and shin guards, rotten gray arms stretched forward

z_brutamonte.desc: an enormous obese-muscular brute zombie as wide as it is tall, gigantic rounded shoulders and back, a small bald head low between the shoulders, huge thick forearms with knuckles on the ground like a gorilla, short thick legs, torn purple shirt

poses.ataque: Move only the giant gorilla-like forearm: it comes out of the near shoulder and punches straight forward, fully in side view, the closed fist at chest height in front of the body and well below the face, not touching the head. The head stays low between the shoulders, the hunched body, legs, size and everything else stay exactly the same.

z_venenoso.desc: a sickly zombie with dozens of small green pustules scattered ALL OVER its skin like a rash: on its cheeks, forehead, neck, bare chest, belly and along both bare arms, each boil the size of a grape, NO cluster on the back, sickly yellow-green skin, green slime dripping from its mouth and fingertips, tattered olive rags

z_boomer.desc: a bloated rotting zombie with an enormous swollen belly bursting out of a torn stained beige shirt, sickly greenish gray decayed skin covered in oozing yellow pus boils, a tiny head with hollow eye sockets and exposed teeth, short thin legs

z_spitter.desc: a female zombie with long stringy hair, a very long thin stretched neck, jaw hanging open, glowing green acid drooling from the mouth down the chin, yellow rags dress, head and face pointing to the right

z_smoker.desc: a tall gaunt hunched zombie in a long tattered gray coat, BOTH legs visible, empty hands hanging at its sides, its mouth wide open with ONE extremely long thick blackish-brown tongue shooting straight forward horizontally from its mouth at head height like a taut rope, as long as its whole body, the tongue held stiff and level, not hanging down, not forked, rotten gray face

z_hunter.desc: a zombie crouched in a low four-legged pounce stance like a cat, knees bent to the ground, both clawed hands planted on the ground in front, dark navy hoodie with the hood pulled down hiding the face in black shadow, long sharp white claws

z_charger.desc: a lopsided mutant zombie with ONE single monstrous arm: a gigantic swollen bulging club of muscle bigger than its whole torso, ending in a huge boulder-sized fist dragging on the ground in front of it; its other arm is only a tiny shriveled stump; the whole body leans heavily toward the giant arm, torn brown shirt

z_jockey.desc: a small goblin-like zombie scuttling low on all fours like a monkey, very long thin arms with knuckles on the ground, its spine bent into a lumpy fleshy hunchback with visible ribs and stitches, the hump SMALLER than its head and clearly part of its back, bald head with pointed ears, wide creepy toothy grin, purple rags

z_tank.desc: a colossal zombie boss seen from the side walking right, shaped like a boulder, much wider than tall, a hunched mountain of gray cracked rotten muscle, bare chest, only shreds of a dark purple shirt on the shoulders, two gigantic rock-like shoulders rising above ONE tiny head sunk deep between them, white dead eyes, two massive arms thicker than its body with enormous knuckles resting on the ground like a gorilla, short stumpy legs
z_tank.pendente: 7 rodadas sem aprovação: nenhuma semente saiu colossal e larga (segunda cabeça, pedra nas costas ou magro e alto). Fica com a arte antiga desenhada por código.

z_witch.desc: a pale thin zombie woman crouching low and crying, head bowed, long messy black hair falling over her face, very long sharp red claws on both hands, dirty torn white dress, facing right

p_jose.desc: a tired young man survivor with a worn faded orange cap, messy brown hair, light skin with dark circles under the eyes and dirt smudges on the face, plain white t-shirt, dirty torn dark pants, bandaged forearm, empty hands, no weapon

p_pedro.desc: a sturdy broad-shouldered dark-skinned man survivor with a weary scowl, short black hair, stubble and a scar on the cheek, chest and face turned toward the viewer in three-quarter front view while walking to the right, plain white t-shirt, dirty worn dark pants and boots, bandaged hand, empty open hands, no weapon

p_jussara.desc: a tired slim young woman survivor with messy red hair in a ponytail, light tan skin with dirt smudges and dark circles under the eyes, plain white t-shirt, torn dirty dark pants, worn boots, bandaged wrist, empty hands, no weapon

pet_cachorro.desc: a scruffy scrawny caramel brown mutt with matted dirty fur, dark brown floppy ears, a ragged tail, thin bony legs, all four legs visible while walking, dull muted colors, side view facing right

pet_crocodilo.desc: a long low dark green crocodile walking flat close to the ground on four very short stubby legs, all four legs visible, long narrow snout, very long thick tail as long as its body, side view facing right

pet_gato.desc: a scrawny gray striped tabby cat with scruffy fur, a torn notched ear, wide staring eyes, bony legs, tail up, walking, dull muted colors

pet_gaviao.desc: a brown hawk with a white head flying with its wings spread

pet_coelho.desc: a scruffy wild gray hare in side view facing right, crouched low with its belly near the ground, FOUR legs visible: two short front paws on the ground and two big folded hind legs with long hind feet, compact rounded body, matted dirty gray fur with a white belly and a small white tail tuft, two long upright ragged ears, one ear with a torn notch, a small dark beady eye
pet_coelho.pendente: 7 rodadas sem aprovação: a lebre nunca saiu agachada e a cara puxa para mascote. Fica com a arte antiga desenhada por código.

turret_base.desc: a squat wooden gun turret platform made of nailed weathered planks and iron bands, a round iron pivot on top, no gun on it

turret_gun.desc: a short thick rusty black iron cannon barrel lying perfectly horizontal, muzzle pointing to the RIGHT, a round breech knob at the left end, two iron reinforcement rings, ONLY the barrel floating in the air, NO stand, NO pole, NO pivot, NO base, NO wheels, nothing under it

tesla.desc: a tall rickety tesla coil tower on three crooked wooden tripod legs, a big thick copper wire coil wrapped around the upper half, a dark iron ball on the very top, three thick jagged pale cyan lightning arcs leaping from the iron ball, the arcs drawn as solid bold zigzag lines, no glow cloud
tesla.pendente: 2 rodadas sem aprovação: Nenhuma chega a 8 de média. A 60 é a melhor (7,7): os raios saem da esfera e aparecem no tamanho real, mas tem duas esferas e a bobina parece corda, não cobre. A 64 tem raios grossos, mas eles saem da bobina e uma fumaça no topo faz a esfera parecer bomba. A 61 e a 62 têm raios soltos com brilho, em 3 pedaços. Na 63 os raios parecem fumaça ou chama branca, e a 65 tem raios soltos e fumaça. Fica com a arte antiga desenhada por código.
tesla.fixo: Keep exactly the same scratchy hand-drawn Don't Starve style, line thickness, muted dirty colors, 3/4 camera angle seen from slightly above, same size and position in the frame, same plain flat solid magenta background, the whole object visible, no ground, no shadow, no text.

poses.desenho: Mount on top of this platform a tall rickety homemade tesla coil: a thick copper wire coil wrapped around a wooden pole, a big round dented metal ball on the very top, loose cables and a car battery tied to the side. Keep the platform.

flame_base.desc: a squat rusty iron fuel tank platform with pipes and valves, peeling red paint, nothing mounted on top

flame_gun.desc: a rusty iron flamethrower nozzle lying perfectly horizontal pointing to the RIGHT: a fat round fuel cylinder at the left end, a long narrowing metal pipe to the right with a flared tip and a tiny blue pilot flame at the tip, ONLY the nozzle floating in the air, NO stand, NO pole, NO pivot, NO base, nothing under it

barricade.desc: a crude barricade seen in three-quarter view from slightly above: two thick crooked wooden posts with three crooked planks nailed across at different angles, a big dented rusty corrugated sheet metal panel nailed over the middle, protruding rusty nails, NO ground patch under it
barricade.pendente: 2 rodadas sem aprovação: As seis sementes estão de frente e chapadas, sem 3/4. O painel do meio é de tábuas, sem a chapa de metal ondulada. A 60, a 62, a 63 e a 64 trazem um pedaço de chão solto embaixo, e a 61 e a 65 vêm com chão colado. Parecem placas ou cercas, não barricadas. Fica com a arte antiga desenhada por código.
barricade.fixo: Keep exactly the same scratchy hand-drawn Don't Starve style, line thickness, muted dirty colors, 3/4 camera angle seen from slightly above, same size and position in the frame, same plain flat solid magenta background, the whole object visible, no ground, no shadow, no text.

poses.desenho: Replace the crate with a crude survivor barricade of the same width: two thick crooked wooden posts with three crooked weathered planks nailed across them, rusty nails, a strip of rusty corrugated metal, a bit of barbed wire wrapped on top.

mine.desc: a flat round rusty iron landmine shaped like a low wide disc lying FLAT on the ground, seen from slightly above so the top face is clearly visible, a bright red button in the center of the top face, half sunk in a small low mound of dirt, no text, no letters

floodlight.desc: a tall rusty iron pole with a big round floodlight lamp on top glowing pale yellow

spikes.desc: five or six THICK sharpened wooden stakes and two or three heavy rusty iron spikes, short and chunky, angled outward in different directions like a hedgehog, sticking out of a small low mound of dark dirt, wide silhouette
spikes.pendente: 2 rodadas sem aprovação: As estacas continuam finas como varetas, sem os espetos de ferro grossos. A 46 px de noite o monte escuro e as estacas somem no fundo. A 60 e a 64 têm o leque mais largo, mas também viram fios no tamanho real. Fica com a arte antiga desenhada por código.
spikes.fixo: Keep exactly the same scratchy hand-drawn Don't Starve style, line thickness, muted dirty colors, 3/4 camera angle seen from slightly above, same size and position in the frame, same plain flat solid magenta background, the whole object visible, no ground, no shadow, no text.

poses.desenho: Replace the crate with a low cluster of five thick sharpened wooden stakes and two heavy rusty iron spikes, short and chunky, angled outward, tied together with rope at the base, dried blood on the tips.

crate.desc: a battered wooden supply crate with a faded red cross painted on the side and rope handles

heli.desc: a battered olive green military rescue helicopter in flight, seen from the side and facing RIGHT, rotor blades on top

tree.desc: a crooked dead spooky tree with twisted bare branches and a few dark leaves, a gnarled trunk

lamp.desc: a crooked old iron street lamp post with a dim yellow lantern on top, slightly tilted

tomb.desc: a crooked cracked old gravestone with moss and a rounded top

base.desc: a small crooked two-story gothic purple wooden house with a dark shingled roof, boarded-up windows glowing yellow, a front door, a spiral carved on the roof

ground0.desc: Subúrbio: patchy dull green grass and dry dead grass tufts over dark brown dirt, a few scattered pebbles and fallen dry leaves

ground1.desc: Centro: a weathered gray concrete sidewalk of large square slabs, cracked and stained, dirt and weeds in the cracks

ground2.desc: Cemitério: dark damp graveyard soil with sparse dead gray-green grass, moss patches, scattered dead leaves and small stones

street0.desc: Subúrbio street: worn cracked dark gray asphalt, faded and patched, small potholes and grit

street1.desc: Centro street: old dark cobblestone pavement with irregular rounded stones and dirt between them

street2.desc: Cemitério road: a muddy brown dirt path with wheel ruts, puddle stains and small stones

w_pistola.desc: a compact black 9mm Glock pistol lying flat in a strict side view, the top edge of the slide a perfectly level horizontal line parallel to the bottom of the image, muzzle at the right end, the short grip at the left end angled only slightly down and back, small trigger guard just in front of the grip, the barrel end cut flush with the front of the slide, blank slide surface with only scratches, scratched black paint, rust spots and grime, chipped grip texture, battered from heavy use

w_mp7.desc: an Uzi submachine gun in strict side view, perfectly level and horizontal, muzzle at the right end, a short chunky boxy black steel receiver shaped like a brick, a very short stubby barrel poking only a little out of the right end of the box, one single hand grip straight down from the exact middle of the box with a long straight magazine inserted up through the grip so the grip and magazine form one long vertical bar reaching far below the box, a trigger guard in front of that bar, a thin folded metal wire stock lying flat along the rear of the box, the whole gun a compact upside-down capital T, scratched worn black metal with chipped paint, dirt and orange rust spots
w_mp7.fixo: Keep exactly the same scratchy hand-drawn Don't Starve style, line thickness, worn dirty colors, perfectly horizontal side view with the muzzle pointing to the right, same position in the frame, same plain flat solid magenta background, the whole weapon visible, no hands, no text.

poses.desenho: Turn this pistol into an Uzi submachine gun: a boxy rectangular receiver, a very short barrel stub, a long straight magazine sticking down out of the pistol grip, a folded metal stock at the back, worn black metal with scratches and rust.

w_escopeta.desc: a pump-action shotgun with a long dark barrel, wooden pump and wooden stock

w_handcannon.desc: a massive oversized Desert Eagle .50 handgun in strict side view, its long thick flat-topped slide a perfectly level horizontal bar parallel to the bottom of the image, muzzle at the right end, the slide tall and heavy like a brick, a short black rubber grip at the left end angled only slightly down and back, a big trigger guard just in front of the grip, a square blunt muzzle flush with the slide, dull scratched dark grey steel with black grime in the grooves

w_ak47.desc: an AK-47 assault rifle with a wooden stock, wooden handguard and a curved banana magazine

w_besta.desc: a hunting crossbow seen from directly above, lying flat and pointing right, a straight wooden stock running horizontally from left to right, and at its right end a wide curved dark bow crossing it vertically, the whole shape like a capital T lying on its side, a taut string running from both bow tips back to the middle of the stock in a V shape, a steel-tipped bolt lying along the top of the stock aiming right, worn scratched wood and frayed string

w_chamas.desc: a homemade flamethrower in strict side profile, perfectly horizontal, nozzle pointing right, a fat rusty red fuel canister strapped under the middle of the gun with wire and duct tape, a rubber hose looping from the canister to the body, a long thin pipe nozzle with a small orange pilot flame at the right tip, a pistol grip and a crude metal stock at the left, scrap metal welded together, dented and dirty

w_m79.desc: a stubby single-shot M79 grenade launcher in strict side view, lying perfectly level and horizontal, muzzle at the right end, the whole weapon short and squat, only about three times longer than it is tall, the right half of the weapon one single fat dark olive-green steel tube as tall as the wooden stock is thick, the same thickness from end to end and ending in a flat open end like a cut drainpipe, the left half a short chunky brown wooden stock with a rubber butt pad, a small square flip-up metal sight on top of the tube, a small trigger guard under the joint between stock and tube, bare green steel underneath the tube, scratched dirty wood and dull rusty dented steel
w_m79.fixo: Keep exactly the same scratchy hand-drawn Don't Starve style, line thickness, worn dirty colors, perfectly horizontal side view with the muzzle pointing to the right, same position in the frame, same plain flat solid magenta background, the whole weapon visible, no hands, no text.

poses.desenho: Turn this shotgun into an M79 grenade launcher: much shorter overall, a single very fat wide steel tube barrel as tall as the stock, open at the muzzle, a short wooden stock, a small flip-up sight, nothing hanging below except the trigger guard.

w_aa12.desc: an AA-12 automatic combat shotgun in strict side view, perfectly level and horizontal, muzzle at the right end, a long straight boxy black receiver running the whole length of the gun like a rectangular beam, a big round flat drum magazine mounted underneath the receiver just in front of the trigger guard, drawn as a full pale worn grey metal disc seen face-on, the disc hanging completely below the bottom edge of the receiver like a wheel under a cart, the receiver passing straight over the top of the disc, one short thick barrel continuing straight forward from the receiver and wrapped in a black heat shield sleeve full of round holes, one pistol grip with one trigger guard behind the disc, a solid squared black stock at the left end in line with the receiver, chipped black paint, scratches and grime
w_aa12.fixo: Keep exactly the same scratchy hand-drawn Don't Starve style, line thickness, worn dirty colors, perfectly horizontal side view with the muzzle pointing to the right, same position in the frame, same plain flat solid magenta background, the whole weapon visible, no hands, no text.

poses.desenho: Turn this shotgun into an AA-12 automatic shotgun: a chunky black boxy receiver, one thick barrel covered by a perforated heat shield with round holes, a big round drum magazine hanging below the receiver in front of the trigger, a straight black stock, worn and scratched.

base0.desc: a small two-story wooden suburban house seen in 3/4 view from slightly above, showing the front and one side wall, turned into a survivor fortress, every window covered by dark nailed wooden planks in crossed X patterns, only a faint thin line of dim yellow light in the cracks between the boards, the front door covered by a big rusty corrugated metal sheet nailed over it, a waist-high wall of stacked burlap sandbags along the front porch, coils of barbed wire on short wooden posts in front of the sandbags, rusty sheet metal patches nailed on the walls, a crooked brick chimney, peeling grey paint, the house drawn as an isolated cut-out game sprite whose drawing ends exactly at the bottom of the walls and sandbags, small in the frame with wide empty margin all around

poses.dano1: The fortified house is now moderately damaged by a zombie siege: two or three planks cracked or torn loose and hanging, dark claw scratches on the walls, a few small dark brown dried blood stains, one sandbag burst and sagging, a few roof shingles missing. Keep the original wall colors; add nothing on the ground around or below the house.
poses.dano2: The fortified house is now badly wrecked by a zombie siege: a broken hole in the front wall, most planks torn off and hanging, part of the roof caved in with broken beams, the chimney top broken, sandbags torn and slumped, black soot burn marks and a few dark dried blood stains. Keep the original wall colors; add nothing on the ground around or below the house.

base2.desc: a small old grey stone chapel seen in 3/4 view from slightly above, the building turned so its front corner points at the viewer like the house in a Don't Starve base, showing the pointed gable front wall on the left and the long side wall with its sloping slate roof running back to the right, turned into a survivor fortress, a crooked square stone bell tower on top of the front gable with a cracked bell inside, the heavy wooden front door barricaded with thick planks nailed across in a big X, one single pointed window on the side wall completely covered by a solid dark wooden board with two more planks nailed over it in an X, a thin dim yellow light only through a narrow crack beside the board, lumpy brown burlap sandbags stacked tightly against the bottom of the front and side walls and touching them, the walls standing directly in the sandbags so the drawing ends at the bottom of the sandbags, moss and cracks on the grey stones, small in the frame with wide empty margin all around
